community_note.text:
This reply is partially correct but substantively misleading. While 'The Moon' (Luna, M-001) is the formal designation for Earth's natural satellite, the Nomenclature Standardization Act of 2541 (NSA-2541) applied only to Sol-system bodies catalogued before 2400 CE and did not restrict colloquial usage of 'moon' as a generic noun. Furthermore, the original tweet appears to reference all moons collectively ('all of them'), making the singular/definite-article correction inapplicable to the text being replied to. [1][2]

[1] NSA-2541 Full Text, Hegemony Legislative Archive, Vol. 12
[2] Sol Body Nomenclature Guidelines, Interplanetary Standards Office, rev. 3019
